# Sacramento Notary Co

> Commissioned California notary and certified Notary Signing Agent serving Sacramento and surrounding cities since 2017. Travels to homes, offices, hospitals, hospice and care facilities, 8 AM to 10 PM, seven days; overnight by request. Same day at the standard rate, quoted before we leave. Apostille filing with the California Secretary of State, including same-day counter filing in Sacramento.

- Service area: Mobile notary serving Sacramento, CA 95823 and surrounding cities
- Phone: (916) 302-7057
- Email: info@sacramentonotaryco.com
- Hours: Open 8 AM–10 PM, 7 days; overnight by request
- Credentials: Commissioned California Notary Public since 2017; $15,000 state notary bond (Gov. Code §8212); Certified Notary Signing Agent, background-screened for lender and title approval
- Cities served: Sacramento, Elk Grove, Folsom, Roseville, Citrus Heights, Rancho Cordova, Davis, Woodland
- Hospitals served: UC Davis Medical Center, Sutter Health, Kaiser Permanente, Mercy General, Dignity Health
- Payment: Cash, Check, Credit card, Zelle, Venmo
- Founder: Dante Tindal
- Google rating: 5.0 from 139 reviews (https://maps.app.goo.gl/fgWRJRaWuT7D6Eqa9)
- Sister service (embassy legalization for non-Hague countries): Apostille San Francisco (https://apostillesanfrancisco.com)

## Pricing (visit fee + California's $15 per notarized signature, Gov. Code §8211, unless quoted all-in; quoted before we leave)

- Standard (8 AM–8 PM, same-day included): $55 visit fee; $70 with 1 signature, $85 with 2
- Priority (We leave within the hour): $80 visit fee; $95 with 1 signature, $110 with 2
- Evening (8 PM–10 PM): $95 visit fee; $110 with 1 signature, $125 with 2
- Overnight (10 PM–8 AM, by request): $150 visit fee; $165 with 1 signature, $180 with 2
- Hospital, hospice, skilled nursing, assisted living (Bedside and facility visits): $150 with up to 2 signatures · $15 each additional
- Jail / detention (Main Jail, RCCC): $250 all-inclusive
- Travel: included in Sacramento, Elk Grove, Rancho Cordova; +$25 for Citrus Heights, Folsom, Roseville, Davis, Woodland; farther out quoted on the call.
- Loan signing (flat, all notarizations included): Seller $200 · HELOC $200 · Refinance $250 · Purchase $250. Printing up to 20 pages is included; pages past 20 are priced on the call.
- Power of attorney (standalone, home or office): $100 with up to two signatures, then $15 each; bedside uses the hospital/care-facility rate.
- Estate signing (trust, pour-over will, POA, healthcare directive): visit fee + $15 per signature, capped at $175 for up to two signers at home or office; bedside estate signings use the hospital/care-facility rate.
- Apostille (California documents, all state fees included): standard $150, 5–10 business days; same-day counter filing $199 if the document reaches us by noon (return shipping extra); each additional document $60.
- California sets the notary fee at $15 per notarized signature (Gov. Code §8211). The visit fee covers travel and scheduling and is quoted before we leave. No notary fee for veterans' benefit forms (Gov. Code §6107).
